statusDetail: External Cloudflare managed challenge redirected to xnhau.video and did not resolve in the browser session. Per the audit method, target-site judgement stopped at recon.

page.notes: The application itself was not reached. The only rendered surface was a Vietnamese Cloudflare verification page at xnhau.video.

artifacts.caption: Atomic manifest of all 58 expected principle/check pairs, generated before evidence collection.
Desktop recon shows only the Cloudflare verification wall.
Mobile recon shows only the same verification wall.
Dark-preference capture remains the verification wall.
Rendered DOM records “Just a moment…”, final URL https://xnhau.video/, and Cloudflare challenge scripts.
Raw fetch failed and browser/crawler inspection did not reach target content.
Discoverability browser view shows the verification wall.
Discoverability crawler view shows the verification wall.
Headers observed on the challenge response, not treated as target-site findings.
Cookie probe observed the blocked challenge state.
Third-party probe observed challenge infrastructure only.
Secrets scan observed no exposed sensitive secret in the challenge state.
Image probe describes the challenge page only, not the target site.

This check is only meaningful where the page has a real interaction to repeat; for a static page with none, mark it not-applicable with a rationale rather than fabricating one.).
